candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The output variable u/U is a dimensionless ratio of the streamwise velocity u to the free-stream velocity U, hence it has no physical dimensions. These four quantities are sufficient to form the dimensionless group u/U in the Blasius laminar boundary layer problem.
